notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build year, designer, builder, staffing or access information found. The Alabama state forestry history PDF has no Cains Ridge mention, so it is not cited. Register elevation 617 ft (188 m) matches the record; a search snippet from another site gave 178 ft, which is not used. The 1819 News piece is general Alabama context, not about this tower. The story's climbing advice is precautionary. The register page was searched for access, visit, build and climb wording and none was found, so the no-public-access line rests on that absence rather than a quote; the earlier evidence row that quoted the height line for it was removed.
